instructions.detail_wheel: Fill the frame with one wheel and its tyre.
instructions.detail_headlights: Photograph one headlight at an angle from the front.
instructions.detail_taillights: Photograph one tail light at an angle from the rear.
instructions.detail_trunk_open: Open the boot and photograph it from behind.
instructions.detail_engine: Open the bonnet and photograph the engine bay from the front.
instructions.detail_roof: Photograph the roof or sunroof from a raised position.
instructions.detail_other: Photograph another detail, for example damage.
instructions.interior_cockpit: Photograph the cockpit through the open driver's door.
instructions.interior_console: Photograph the centre console and screen.
instructions.interior_instruments: Photograph the steering wheel and instruments with the ignition on.
instructions.interior_front_seats: Photograph the front seats through the door.
instructions.interior_rear_seats: Photograph the rear seats through the rear door.
instructions.interior_door: Photograph the inside of a door.
instructions.interior_trunk: Photograph the inside of the boot.
